findings.observation: Update interval 0.5; maximum nearby rows 10 and party slots 5. Limits are source constants, not proof of actual API coverage.
Unit.List is explicitly marked unverified; Lookup and Detail wrappers exist. API absence or failure can return nil.
buildCoord returns nil if all coordinates absent but can otherwise emit partial XYZ; consumer must not substitute zero.
readUnit uses detail.id or unitSpecOrId; the fallback can be a unit specifier instead of a qualified object identity.

DirectAPI nearby enumeration excludes player and target, iterates unordered pairs, retains at most 10, and returns nil both for no retained rows and unavailable list. No exhaustive or distance-sorted census established.
Party collection is a separate bounded scope; absent or empty result likewise becomes nil.
DirectAPI snapshot combines independent player/target/party/nearby observations without a proven atomic scene snapshot; target may be self.
Alternate sourceMode is ReaderBridge, not JSHUD; this branch explicitly sets nearbyUnits=nil while retaining player/target and party.

retainedObservation.coverage: player-only; no nearby entities, geometry or camera fields
retainedObservation.currentFreshness: unverified; old bound/fresh flags never promoted

consumerDecisions: Merge matching actual IDs only within one input hash; retain source roles, exact observations and conflicts.
Reject specifier/address IDs, mismatched root IDs, invalid numeric/partial coordinate data and unsupported envelopes.
Never interpret names, identical coordinates, missing nearby data or old freshness flags as verified world recognition.
Retain recorded versus synthetic labels; all collision, support, visibility and reachability stay unknown.
